questions.asked: Use the calculate tool for this. Do not work it out yourself. What is 2 to the power of 0.5, times 10? Round to 3 decimals.

questions.asked: Use the calculate tool for this. Do not work it out yourself. What is the square root of 2, times 100? Round to 2 decimals.
questions.reply: The result of (\sqrt{2} \times 100) rounded to two decimal places is 141.42.

questions.asked: Use the calculate tool for this. Do not work it out yourself. A right triangle has legs of 5 and 12. How long is the hypotenuse?
questions.reply: The length of the hypotenuse, calculated using the Pythagorean theorem ((a^2 + b^2)^{0.5}) with (a = 5) and (b = 12), gives (\sqrt{25 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13). Rounded to two decimal places, the hypotenuse is 13.00.

questions.asked: Use the calculate tool for this. Do not work it out yourself. 1000 dollars grows at 5 percent a year, compounded yearly, for 10 years. What is the final amount? Round to 2 decimals.
questions.reply: The final amount after compounding yearly for 10 years is $1,628.89.
